svg.aria-label: Three illustrative journeys: Fatou, a farmer in Kaolack on a basic phone in French; Amina, an expectant mother in Kano using voice in Hausa; and Grace, a health worker in Kakamega using eCHIS in Swahili. Each gets one decision, one short answer and one next step.
